Once the clustering and metaclustering and UMAPs are done, and clusters are named, we can proceed to the analysis of the frequencies of each metacluster between the different sample groups, as well as differences in the MFI of the markers

```{r}

fsom_PA_up<- readRDS(file= file.path(paths$rds,"fsom_PA_allmarkers_renamed_20261107.RDS"))
fsom_PB_up<- readRDS(file= file.path(paths$rds,"fsom_PB_allmarkers_renamed_20261107.RDS"))

#extract the counts of each metacluster within each sample, calculate the proportions and the center-log-ratio to compare them
#this function extracts the SAMPLE ID of each cell of the flowsom object

meta_PA <- readRDS(file.path(paths$metadata, "metadata_PA_20261102.rds"))
meta_PB <- readRDS(file.path(paths$metadata, "metadata_PB_20261102.rds"))

meta_PA$antiCSP_M3 <- factor(meta_PA$antiCSP_M3,
                                 levels = c("Low", "High", "Control"))   
meta_PA$sex <- factor(meta_PA$sex,
                                 levels = c("F", "M"))   
meta_PB$antiCSP_M3 <- factor(meta_PB$antiCSP_M3,
                                 levels = c("Low", "High", "Control"))   
meta_PB$sex <- factor(meta_PB$sex,
                                 levels = c("F", "M"))   

meta_PA <- tibble::rownames_to_column(meta_PA, var = "file_name")
meta_PB<- tibble::rownames_to_column(meta_PB, var = "file_name")

```

```{r}

cell_file <- function(fsom) {
  md <- fsom$metaData
  md <- md[order(sapply(md, `[`, 1))]                 
  lens <- sapply(md, function(r) r[2] - r[1] + 1)
  rep(names(md), times = lens)
}

counts_PA_up <- tibble(file = cell_file(fsom_PA_up),
                 metacluster = factor(GetMetaclusters(fsom_PA_up))) %>%
  dplyr::count(file, metacluster, .drop = FALSE) %>%               
  left_join(meta_PA, by = c("file" = "file_name"))

#dataframe showing the total cells coming from each sample in the flowsom, not used later but to check for consistency

total_counts_PA_up<- counts_PA_up %>% group_by(file) %>% summarise(total = sum(n)) 

#remove the control group to not include them in the comparisons

counts_PA_up <- counts_PA_up %>% dplyr::filter(antiCSP_M3 %in% c("High", "Low")) %>%
  mutate(antiCSP_M3 = droplevels(factor(antiCSP_M3)))

#calculate the proportions of each metacluster in each individual and the center log ratio
#adding 0.5 in the counts in order to not have 0 values that cannot be log transformed

props_PA_up <- counts_PA_up %>%
  complete(file, metacluster, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%   
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(prop     = n / sum(n),
         percent  = 100 * prop,
         prop_adj = (n + 0.5) / sum(n + 0.5),
         clr      = log(prop_adj) - mean(log(prop_adj))) %>%
  ungroup()

#compare the frequencies or CLR-transformed frequencies of each metacluster between High and Low responders
#later in the plotting function the wilcoxon test is applied again, this is only to check the results of the comparisons

res_PA_up <- props_PA_up %>%
  group_by(metacluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_high = sum(antiCSP_M3 == "High"),
    n_low  = sum(antiCSP_M3 == "Low"),
    median_clr_high = median(clr[antiCSP_M3 == "High"]),
    median_clr_low  = median(clr[antiCSP_M3 == "Low"]),
    p = wilcox.test(clr ~ antiCSP_M3, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p)

# create labels for the n of each group

n_per_group_PA <- props_PA_up %>% distinct(file, antiCSP_M3) %>% count(antiCSP_M3)
lab_PA <- setNames(paste0(n_per_group_PA$antiCSP_M3, "\n(n = ", n_per_group_PA$n, ")"),
                n_per_group_PA$antiCSP_M3)

#same analysis for the panel B data

counts_PB_up <- tibble(file = cell_file(fsom_PB_up),
                 metacluster = factor(GetMetaclusters(fsom_PB_up))) %>%
```

```{r}
#Calculate the median fluorescence intensity of each marker in each metacluster for each sample

sample_medians <- function(fsom, mclusters=NULL, meta_table, group_var = "antiCSP_M3",
                           levels_keep = c("High", "Low"),
                           channels = unname(fsom$map$colsUsed), min_cells = 0,
                           label_map = NULL) {

  if (is.null(label_map)) {
    cu <- fsom$map$colsUsed
    label_map <- setNames(sub("-A$", "", names(cu)), unname(cu))
  }

if (is.null(mclusters)) {
    mc <- FlowSOM::GetMetaclusters(fsom)
  }
  
  as_tibble(fsom$data[, channels, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    mutate(file = cell_file(fsom), metacluster = factor(mc)) %>%
    group_by(file, metacluster) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n() >= min_cells) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), across(all_of(channels), median), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(meta_table, by = c("file" = "file_name")) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(.data[[group_var]], levels = levels_keep)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(channels), names_to = "marker", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(marker = factor(dplyr::recode(marker, !!!label_map),
                           levels = unname(label_map[channels])))      
}

med_PA <- sample_medians(fsom_PA_up, meta_table= meta_PA)
med_PB <- sample_medians(fsom_PB_up, meta_table=meta_PB)

#calculate the median of the MFIs or each marker within each metacluster in both sample groups and compare them

test_one <- function(d) {
  n_h <- sum(d$group == "High"); n_l <- sum(d$group == "Low")
  if (n_h < 3 || n_l < 3) return(tibble(n_high = n_h, n_low = n_l, diff = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  tibble(n_high = n_h, n_low = n_l,
         diff = median(d$value[d$group == "High"]) - median(d$value[d$group == "Low"]),
         p    = wilcox.test(value ~ group, data = d, exact = FALSE)$p.value)
}

res_PA <- med_PA %>%
  group_by(metacluster, marker) %>%
  group_modify(~ test_one(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p)

res_PB <- med_PB %>%
  group_by(metacluster, marker) %>%
  group_modify(~ test_one(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p)

res_PA
res_PB

#plot a heatmap showing the difference in MFI between high and low for each metacluster and marker and the significant differences

plot_diff_heatmap <- function(res, axis_size = 14, star_size = 8, p_cut = 0.05, fdr_cut = 0.05) {
  res %>%
    mutate(sig = case_when(fdr < fdr_cut ~ "**",      
                           p   < p_cut   ~ "*",       
                           TRUE          ~ "")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(metacluster, marker, fill = diff)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig), size = star_size, fontface = "bold", vjust = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(x = "Metacluster", y = NULL, fill = "high − low\n(median)",
         caption = "* p < 0.05 (unadjusted); ** FDR < 0.05") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = axis_size) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = axis_size),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size),
          legend.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = axis_size - 2),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}

plot_diff_heatmap(res_PA, axis_size=16, star_size = 10)
plot_diff_heatmap(res_PB, axis_size=16, star_size = 10)

#plot the boxplots of the MFI differences between the two groups as boxplots (only the combinations with a significant pvalue)

plot_sig_boxplots <- function(med, res, p_cut = 0.05,
                              ncol = 4, free_y = TRUE) {

  group_cols <- c(
    "High" = "#F8766D",
    "Low"  = "#00BFC4"
  )

  hits <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p), p < p_cut) %>%
    arrange(metacluster, marker) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(metacluster, " · ", marker,
                          "\np = ", signif(p, 2),
                          " (FDR = ", signif(fdr, 2), ")"))

  dat <- med %>%
    inner_join(hits %>% select(metacluster, marker, label),
               by = c("metacluster", "marker")) %>%
    mutate(
      label = factor(label, levels = hits$label),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("High", "Low"))
    )

  ggplot(dat, aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = group),
                width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols) +
    facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = ncol,
               scales = if (free_y) "free_y" else "fixed") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Median expression per sample (logicle)",
         caption = paste0("Wilcoxon rank-sum test; panels shown have unadjusted p < ",
                          p_cut)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

plot_sig_boxplots(med_PA, res_PA)
plot_sig_boxplots(med_PB, res_PB)

#plot histograms showing the fluorescence intensities and counts for each marker and metaclusters, split between two sample groups, and the MFIs of each group as dashed lines

plot_marker_hist <- function(df, marker, group_col = "responder_group",
                             facet_by = NULL,         
                             bins = 100,
                             colours = c(High = "#F8766D", Low = "#00BFC4"),
                             show_median = TRUE,         
                             clip = c(0.001, 0.999),     
                             ncol = NULL,
                             title = NULL,
                             save_path = NULL,
                             y_scales = c("free_y", "fixed"), 
                             panel_width = 3.5, panel_height = 3, dpi = 300) {
  
  stopifnot(length(marker) == 1, marker %in% names(df))
  y_scales <- match.arg(y_scales)
  
  d <- df[!is.na(df[[group_col]]) & !is.na(df[[marker]]), ]
  d$.grp <- droplevels(as.factor(d[[group_col]]))
  d$.x   <- d[[marker]]
  if (!is.null(facet_by)) d$.facet <- as.factor(d[[facet_by]])
 
  xr <- quantile(d$.x, clip, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  med <- d %>%
    group_by(across(any_of(c(".grp", ".facet")))) %>%
    summarise(med = median(.x), .groups = "drop")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(.x, fill = .grp, colour = .grp)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)), bins = bins,
                   position = "identity", alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colours, name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colours, name = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xr) +
    labs(x = marker, y = "Counts",
         title = if (is.null(title)) marker else title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
  
  if (show_median) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(data = med, aes(xintercept = med, colour = .grp),
                        linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE)
  }
  
  n_col <- 1; n_row <- 1
  if (!is.null(facet_by)) {
    n_f <- nlevels(d$.facet)
    if (is.null(ncol)) ncol <- ceiling(sqrt(n_f))
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~ .facet, ncol = ncol, scales=y_scales, axes = "all")
    n_col <- min(ncol, n_f); n_row <- ceiling(n_f / ncol)
  }
    if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = panel_width * n_col + 1.2,
           height = panel_height * n_row, dpi = dpi, limitsize = FALSE)
  }
  
  p
}

plot_marker_hist(umap_PA, "S100A8", group_col = "antiCSP_M3", facet_by = "metacluster_label")
plot_marker_hist(umap_PB, "CCR1", group_col = "antiCSP_M3", facet_by = "metacluster_label")
```

```{r}
#scatter plots of the different metaclusters in high vs low responders

plot_metaclusters <- function(fsom, channelpair, density = FALSE,
                              seed = 42, ncells = 3000) {

  mcs <- sort(unique(as.character(GetMetaclusters(fsom))))   
  mcs_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mcs))
  if (!anyNA(mcs_num)) mcs <- as.character(sort(mcs_num))  

  plots <- lapply(mcs, function(mc) {
    set.seed(seed)                                  
    p <- Plot2DScatters(fsom,
                        channelpairs = list(channelpair),
                        metaclusters = list(if (!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mc)))) as.numeric(mc) else mc),
                        plotFile = NULL,
                        maxBgPoints= ncells)
    p[[1]] + ggtitle(paste("Metacluster", mc))
  })
  names(plots) <- mcs
  plots
}
```

Analyse the relationships of the metacluster proportions in each sample group with their antibody levels at M3

```{r}
#load antibody data

abs <- read.csv(file.path(paths$metadata,"VAMONOS_obj1B_antibody_outcomes.csv")) %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ID = sample) %>%
  mutate(
    analyte    = as.factor(analyte),
    responder = as.factor(responder)
  )%>%
  mutate(ID = str_remove(ID, "A"))

props_PA_up<- props_PA_up[,-c(4)]
props_PB_up<- props_PB_up[,-c(4)]

out_dir_PA <- file.path(paths$output, "Panel A")
out_dir_PB <- file.path(paths$output, "Panel B")

analytes <- levels(abs$analyte)

analytes <- c("IgG_CSP_Cterm_M3", "IgG_CSP_FL_M3", "IgG_CSP_NANP_M3", 
              "IgG_CSP_Cterm_M3M20", "IgG_CSP_FL_M3M20", "IgG_CSP_NANP_M3M20")

#function to perform spearman correlations between the cluster proportions and the antibody analytes, and linear regression: for each cluster, it measures how antibody level changes as that cluster becomes more abundant, while accounting for sex and age.

run_analyte <- function(an, abs, props, out_dir, rho_cutoff = 0.4) {

  message("\n===== Analyte: ", an, " =====")

  pdf_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(an, "_clusters_lineage.pdf"))
  pdf(file = pdf_file, width = 8, height = 6)
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  abs_an <- abs %>%
    dplyr::filter(analyte == an) %>%
    select(ID, value, responder, age, sex)

  df_long <- props %>%
    inner_join(abs_an, by = "ID")

  id_order <- df_long %>%
    distinct(ID, value) %>%
    arrange(value) %>%
    pull(ID)
  df_long <- df_long %>% mutate(ID = factor(ID, levels = id_order))

  cluster_corr <- df_long %>%
    group_by(metacluster) %>%
    summarise(cor = cor(prop, value, method = "spearman"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(cor)))

  top_clusters <- cluster_corr %>% dplyr::filter(abs(cor) > rho_cutoff)

  if (nrow(top_clusters) > 0) {
    print(
      df_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(metacluster %in% top_clusters$metacluster) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = value, y = prop)) +
        geom_point() +
        stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
        facet_wrap(~metacluster, scales = "free_y") +
        labs(x = an, title = paste("Top clusters vs", an)) +
        theme_bw()
    )
  } else {
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.5,
         paste0("No clusters with |rho| > ", rho_cutoff, "\nfor analyte: ", an),
         adj = c(0.5, 0.5), cex = 1.2)
  }

  # ── CLR + lm: cell proportion -> antibody level ──────────────────────────
  covars <- df_long %>%
    distinct(ID, value, sex, age, responder) %>%
    mutate(
      sex       = as.factor(sex),
      responder = factor(responder, levels = c("Low", "High"))
    )

  df_wide <- df_long %>%
    select(ID, metacluster, prop) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = metacluster, values_from = prop,
                values_fill = 0)

  clr_matrix <- as.data.frame(clr(df_wide[, -1] + 1e-6))
  clr_matrix$ID <- df_wide$ID

  clr_long <- clr_matrix %>%
    pivot_longer(-ID, names_to = "metacluster", values_to = "CLR") %>%
    left_join(covars, by = "ID") %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(value, CLR, sex, age)   # lm would drop these silently anyway

  results_an <- clr_long %>%
    group_by(metacluster) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      mod <- lm(scale(value) ~ scale(CLR) + sex + age, data = .x)
      tidy(mod, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::filter(term == "scale(CLR)")
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      analyte     = an,
      p.adj       = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),   # within this analyte
      significant = p.adj < 0.05,
      direction   = ifelse(estimate > 0, "positive", "negative")
    )

  # Order clusters by estimate for the forest plot
  results_an <- results_an %>%
    mutate(Cluster = factor(metacluster,
                            levels = metacluster[order(estimate)]))

  # ── Forest plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  print(
    ggplot(results_an, aes(x = estimate, y = Cluster,
                           color = direction, alpha = significant)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
                    orientation = "y", width = 0.3) +
      geom_point(aes(shape = significant), size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(positive = "#E76F51", negative = "#264653"),
                         name = "Direction") +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.3),
                         name = "FDR < 0.05") +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
                         name = "FDR < 0.05") +
      labs(
        x        = "Regression coefficient (95% CI)\nadjusted by sex and age",
        y        = "Cluster",
        title    = paste("CLR + lm -", an),
        subtitle = "Cell cluster proportion -> Antibody level"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )

  message("PDF saved: ", pdf_file)
  results_an
}

# ── Run all analytes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_lm_clr <- list()

for (an in analytes) {
  all_lm_clr[[an]] <- tryCatch(
    run_analyte(an, abs = abs, props = props_PA_up, out_dir = out_dir_PA),
    error = function(e) {
      message("FAILED for ", an, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
}

# ── Combined table with FDR across ALL analytes ──────────────────────────────
all_lm_clr_df <- bind_rows(all_lm_clr) %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj.global      = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    significant.global = p.adj.global < 0.05
  )
```
